body.label: Lips
body.text: His lips have a faint blue tint. Poison, fast acting.

body.label: Right hand
body.text: Still gripping the stem of a port glass.

body.label: Waistcoat pocket
body.text: A note in his writing: "Tell Hollis tonight. The cellar books don't add up."

cards.text: The silver tray and the port decanter. Only Lord Voss's glass has a cloudy film at the bottom. The decanter's label reads:
Two chairs pushed back hard. A torn draft of a will lies in the grate.
Fresh flour scattered on the floor, as if the sacks were moved.
A decanter of port and a ring of the same cloudy film on the counter. The cellar ledger has pages torn out.
Receipts from a wine dealer in the next town, all paid to Hollis Grey.
Mina's notebook: "8:40, light in the cellar window."
A rat poison tin with flour on the lid.

sealed.instructions: Open after the group solves The Cellar Lock
